panels.title: API request rate by service
panels.description: platform_api_requests_total rate, by service. Covers ingestion, analytics, processing, metadata, ops-console, demo-dashboard.

panels.title: API error rate by service
panels.description: platform_api_requests_total rate for 5xx status codes, by service.

panels.title: Event Throughput
panels.description: Raw events received per second, by Kafka topic (cloudscale_stream_events_received_total).

panels.title: Processing Lag
panels.description: cloudscale_stream_processing_lag_seconds and cloudscale_stream_watermark_lag_seconds, by query. Alert: StreamingProcessingLagHigh > 120s for 5m.

panels.title: Micro-Batch Duration (p95)
panels.description: cloudscale_stream_batch_duration_seconds, by query.

panels.title: Events Processed by Domain
panels.description: cloudscale_stream_events_processed_total rate, by event_domain. Shows actual throughput that reached the serving layer.

panels.title: Validation Failure Rate
panels.description: cloudscale_stream_events_failed_total rate, by reason. Alert: StreamingExcessiveValidationFailureRate > 1/s for 10m.

panels.title: Micro-Batches Processed
panels.description: cloudscale_stream_batches_total rate, by query and outcome.

panels.title: Records per Micro-Batch (p95)
panels.description: cloudscale_stream_records_per_batch histogram, by query.

panels.title: Watermark / Late Events
panels.description: cloudscale_stream_events_late_total rate, by classification (on_time excluded — only the exceptions are worth watching here).

panels.title: Recent Late Events (24h, DB)
panels.description: cloudscale_stream_late_events_recent from ops-console DB-derived gauge, by classification.

panels.title: Duplicate Events
panels.description: cloudscale_stream_events_duplicate_total rate (same-micro-batch duplicates; see docs/streaming_architecture.md for the cross-batch dedup tradeoff).

panels.title: DLQ Volume
panels.description: cloudscale_stream_dlq_total increase, by reason. Alert: StreamingDlqGrowthHigh > 50 in 10m.

panels.title: Sink Failures (15m)
panels.description: cloudscale_stream_sink_failures_total increase, by sink. Alert: StreamingSinkFailuresHigh > 0 in 5m (critical).

panels.title: PostgreSQL Health (streaming sink)
panels.description: cloudscale_stream_postgres_available — 1 healthy, 0 retries exhausted. Alert: StreamingPostgresUnavailable.

panels.title: Redis Cache Health / Fallbacks
panels.description: platform_cache_available{cache=redis} (1 healthy, 0 in outage-fallback) and platform_cache_events_total{outcome=unavailable} rate. Alert: RedisUnavailable.

panels.title: Cache Operations by Outcome
panels.description: platform_cache_events_total rate, by outcome (hit/miss/set/unavailable/rate_limit_incr).

panels.title: Kafka Publish Health
panels.description: platform_kafka_events_published_total rate, by status (success/failed). Alert: IngestionPublishFailures.

panels.title: Reconciliation Health (24h)
panels.description: cloudscale_reconciliation_recent_failures / cloudscale_reconciliation_recent_checks, derived from reconciliation_audit by ops-console. Alert: ReconciliationFailuresDetected.

panels.title: Reliability Exercise Results
panels.description: cloudscale_reliability_exercise_last_status{scenario_id} (1 passed, 0 failed) and last_run_age_seconds, derived from pipeline_run_log by ops-console. See docs/reliability.md.

panels.title: Checkpoint Freshness
panels.description: cloudscale_stream_checkpoint_age_seconds (live process) and cloudscale_stream_checkpoint_freshness_seconds_db (database view, from ops-console). Alerts: StreamingCheckpointStale, StreamingCheckpointStaleFromDatabase.

panels.title: Serving Metrics Staleness
panels.description: cloudscale_serving_metrics_staleness_seconds, by serving table. Alert: ServingMetricsStale > 3h.

panels.title: Pipeline Run Outcomes
panels.description: Pipeline runs logged to pipeline_run_log, surfaced as cloudscale_reliability_exercise_last_status for reliability scenarios. See docs/reliability.md.
